snippet.title: Alkahest – Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first tease of gameplay from Alkahest, a new first-person medieval fantasy action-adventure RPG from developer Push On that bills itself as a spiritual successor to Dark Messiah of Might & Magic – while also citing Dishonored and Kingdom Come: Deliverance as its influences. In it, you'll engage in close-quarters combat, explore realistic medieval locations, learn alchemy, and more. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016620/Alkahest/

#IGN #Gaming
